summary: The 8-K reports entry into a material definitive agreement — the Second Amendment and Lender Joinder to the Credit Agreement by BXPE US Aggregator (CYM) L.P., an affiliate of Blackstone Private Equity Strategies Fund L.P. and its TE L.P. The amendment increases aggregate commitments to $2.65 billion, extends the scheduled maturity date to May 25, 2029 with two further one-year extension options, and updates interest rate terms. This is a routine credit facility amendment for borrowing capacity, not a special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No equity issuance, tender offer, or strategic transaction is involved; it is a debt facility amendment for investment activities.
